sources.title: CC-TUMOR-HETEROGENEITY collection page
sources.version: Version 2; page states updated 2023-02-23; citation label says Version 1
sources.accessMethod: official search index only; direct page open returned HTTP 500
sources.summary: Indexed page lists 23 subjects, 171 studies, 821 series, 131556 images, DICOM and Clinical XLSX with CC BY 4.0; reports a Clinical V2 time-to-distant-metastasis value addition without an endpoint codebook.
sources.applicability: Current release metadata only. Does not establish ROI identities, clinical field semantics, patient join, or Series timepoints.

sources.title: Cervical Cancer – Tumor Heterogeneity: Serial Functional and Molecular Imaging Across the Radiation Therapy Course in Advanced Cervical Cancer (CC-Tumor-Heterogeneity)
sources.version: Historical collection page; page marked last modified 2024-04-11; Versions section describes V1 and V2
sources.summary: Describes tumor-volume contours as included for each case and imaging timepoint and gives protocol-level treatment timepoints. Also contains an unexplained 'No labels' note under V1; page wording does not identify DICOM ROI numbers/names or code clinical endpoints.
sources.applicability: Collection-level descriptions only; no per-RTSTRUCT crosswalk or per-patient timepoint table.

sources.title: Collection Details CC-Tumor-Heterogeneity
sources.summary: Lists 23 subjects, cervix primary site, CT/MR/PT/REG/RTSTRUCT modalities, cervical cancer, and Clinical supporting data; directs users to TCIA collection page for metadata.
sources.applicability: Collection metadata; no file-level or identity/ROI validation.

sources.institution: Wiley / Journal of Magnetic Resonance Imaging
sources.title: Tumor radiomic heterogeneity: Multiparametric functional imaging to characterize variability and predict response following cervical cancer radiation therapy
sources.summary: Abstract reports 21 participants; pre-RT, early 2-week and mid 5-week imaging; response assessed one month after treatment completion by a radiation oncologist using manually delineated tumor-volume changes.
sources.applicability: Published-study cohort and protocol only; not a Clinical V2 codebook or released DICOM ROI identity map.
sources.publicContactRoute: Corresponding author Stephen R. Bowen, PhD; srbowen@uw.edu appears in PMC search-indexed article text. Wiley page directly confirms corresponding author but masks the email link.

sources.title: Bowen et al. full text, PMCID PMC5899626
sources.accessMethod: targeted official search index; direct open triggered reCAPTCHA; no PDF downloaded
sections: DCE MRI, DW MRI and FDG PET/CT acquisition
sources.summary: Search-indexed article text describes tumor and uterus delineation on reference sagittal T2 and a paper-specific response threshold of residual volume below 10% of baseline; index text also contains protocol dose/timepoint details.
sources.applicability: Research-paper method only. Threshold and contours cannot be mapped onto Clinical V2 fields or individual released RTSTRUCT objects.
